content: Kunal Mehta called insurance agent Anita Sharma to confirm that he will submit the signed declaration form and property valuation report as a single PDF tomorrow morning. They discussed formatting requirements for the valuation report, and Anita agreed to email the bank transfer account details for the $850 premium along with a document checklist. Anita also confirmed that the policy status will change from Pending to Active once the documents are verified.

action_items: Kunal to send signed declaration form and property valuation report tomorrow morning
Anita to email bank account details and document checklist
Anita to verify documents and update policy status to Active
